title: Frame React Component
description: Renders the window's five-band geometry: title bar, switcher bar, tool window, terminal band, and status bar, with resizable split between tool window and secondary panel.
params: props: FrameProps (kind, slots, panelCollapsed, panelWidth, etc.)
semantics: Arranges five fixed-height bands in a column with a resizable split row; only the middle row grows; regions arrive as pre-built slots.
